data.title: bn-qxb1: adapt profile authority to protocol v4 relocated run-claim
data.description: profile_adapters.py (never touched by bn-2vih) opened v3 prepared claims/single-use-claim.json; v4 relocated the claim to output/run-claim.json. validate_profile_authority now derives prepared_root lexically from the recorded single_use_claim.path (no open), keeps prepared-root 0555, drops v3 claims/-0700 + single-use file custody, and replays the identical 9-field claim record (schema bn-2l3n-prepared-claim-v3) from attempt_prepared_path.with_name('run-claim.json') which the runner freezes+phase-verifies. All claim cross-checks and content-hash grounding preserved; only single-use-file custody relaxed, matching bn-2vih. test_profile_adapters.py fixtures updated to v4 layout + missing-run-claim rejection test added. Coverage note: runner self-test uses _FakeProfiles so it never exercised this; test_profile_adapters.py is the real suite. Fable-mapped, verified vs v12 rehearsal run-claim.json. Tests: profile_adapters 60/60, runner 163/163, verifier 187/187. Commit a60e650.
